notes: WP REST API and wp-sitemap return 410. /sitemap (single file) lists ~2833 articles under /brands/<category>/<slug>, ordered newest-first, but lastmod is migration date (all Oct 2026); real dates taken from each article page JSON-LD datePublished. Fetched the newest 720 article pages (sitemap order); the 2026 articles are indices 0-591 (index 720 is Oct 2025, so nothing 2026 is missed unless sitemap order is non-monotone beyond that). Two pages 404 (idx 376, 569) and two pages have no datePublished (not included). Releases vs excluded decided by manual title review (excluded guides, lists, interviews, events, reviews/hands-ons, spotlights/vintage features, industry news, WatchTime New York roundups, auctions); sponsored new-watch articles kept. Site has no spec box; refs only regex-extracted from body text "ref./reference X" so few. brand/model left empty (no explicit field). Category = articleSection. img = og:image.
